company.name: Advano
company.shortDescription: Advano is a renewable energy power company delivering a scalable silicon solution for lithium-ion batteries.
company.description: Advano is a New Orleans-based company delivering a scalable solution for lithium-ion batteries with higher energy density. By conquering the challenges of silicon, Advano integrates or completely replaces graphite in today’s lithium-ion batteries with its advanced silicon anode material - improving the longevity of lithium-ion batteries for battery manufacturers and Tier one consumer electronics and automotive companies.

productsAndServices.description: A customizable platform material technology designed for enhancing lithium-ion batteries by addressing silicon side-effects through a porous, conductive architecture.

aiResearchSummary.text: Advano is engaged in developing silicon-based materials for lithium-ion batteries, as shown by work on silicon anode compositions formed by dispersing silicon in specific solvents and milling, described in 'Silicon anode and batteries made therefrom.' Research also covers nanosized silicon particulates produced via milling in polar solvents, as detailed in 'Nano silicon particulates, method to make them and articles made therefrom,' and porous silicon-carbon matrix composites for battery use, as in 'Silicon electrolyte composite particles, compositions and uses in lithium ion.'
